previous_lessons: Legacy migrations fail when you treat the code as the source of truth while ignoring the undocumented side effects in the database.
A constrained pool creates a predictable system.
A container limit is a hard ceiling for the entire process, not just your heap; always leave a 25% buffer for the JVM's internal tax.
A system that knows when to say no is more resilient than one that tries to do everything until it dies.
